title: Arabic Language Café continues at Oodi
content:
Are you learning Arabic or interested in its culture? We are delighted to invite you to the Arabic Language Café, organized by the Finnish Institute in the Middle East in cooperation with the Oodi Library and the Middle East Students Association (Lio).

Starting Thursday, September 3rd, we will meet every Thursday from 4.30 PM to 6.00 PM at Oodi (Group Room 4). The café is an informal yet structured and friendly space to practice Arabic, explore various topics, and meet fellow students and native Arabic speakers. Each session is led by an Arabic-speaking facilitator, and we also host guests from the community.

Participation is free and open to all those interested in the Arabic language.

Join us – let’s practice, connect, and bring Arabic to life at the Oodi!
